_comment: AUTHORED. The incomplete-window caveat, kept separate from stale-cards because incomplete_card_count and stale_cards are computed and rendered independently — a combined scenario can hide a regression in either. All three cards are FRESH (fetched within the hour), so stale_cards is empty and incomplete_card_count is the only caveat on the payload. count_incomplete_windows counts only last_window_complete IS FALSE, never NULL, so the three cards below are one FALSE, one TRUE and one NULL: the count must be 1, and a change that started counting NULL as incomplete would badge two.
